/api/dashboards:
    get:
      description: Returns a paginated list of dashboards. Each result includes title, description, tags, and metadata, but not the full panel layout. Use `GET /api/dashboards/{id}` to retrieve the complete state.
      operationId: get-dashboards
      parameters:
        - description: The page of results to return.
          in: query
          name: page
          required: false
          schema:
            default: 1
            minimum: 1
            type: number
        - description: The number of results to return per page.
          in: query
          name: per_page
          required: false
          schema:
            default: 20
            maximum: 1000
            minimum: 1
            type: number
        - description: Filters results by `title` and `description` using Elasticsearch [`simple_query_string`](https://www.elastic.co/docs/reference/query-languages/query-dsl/query-dsl-simple-query-string-query) syntax. Multi-word terms require all words to match.
          in: query
          name: query
          required: false
          schema:
            type: string
        - description: A tag ID to include. Accepts a single tag ID or multiple tag IDs. When multiple are specified, library items matching any of the tag IDs are included.
          in: query
          name: tags
          required: false
          schema:
            default: []
            description: Tag IDs associated with this dashboard.
            items:
              maxLength: 250
              type: string
            maxItems: 100
            type: array
        - description: A tag ID to exclude. Accepts a single tag ID or multiple tag IDs. When multiple are specified, library items matching any of the tag IDs are excluded.
          in: query
          name: excluded_tags
          required: false
          schema:
            default: []
            description: Tag IDs associated with this dashboard.
            items:
              maxLength: 250
              type: string
            maxItems: 100
            type: array
        - description: A tag name to include. Accepts a single tag name or multiple tag names. When multiple are specified, library items matching any of the tag names are included. If the same name is shared by multiple tags, items matching any of those tags are included.
          in: query
          name: tag_names
          required: false
          schema:
            items:
              type: string
            maxItems: 100
            type: array
            x-state: Generally available; added in 9.6.0
        - description: A tag name to exclude. Accepts a single tag name or multiple tag names. When multiple are specified, library items matching any of the tag names are excluded. If the same name is shared by multiple tags, items matching any of those tags are excluded.
          in: query
          name: excluded_tag_names
          required: false
          schema:
            items:
              type: string
            maxItems: 100
            type: array
            x-state: Generally available; added in 9.6.0

          content:
            application/json:
              examples:
                searchDashboardsResponse:

                    Paginated list of dashboard summaries. Each item includes the ID, a subset of dashboard state fields (`title`, `time_range` if set), and metadata. Full panel content is not included - use the GET endpoint to retrieve a specific dashboard.

                  value:
                    data:
                      - data:

                          version: WzEwMiwxXQ==

                    meta:

                    type: object

                      data:

                        items:
                          additionalProperties: false
                          type: object
                          properties:
                            data:
                              additionalProperties: false
                              type: object
                              properties:
                                access_control:
                                  $ref: '#/components/schemas/Kibana_HTTP_APIs_kbn-dashboard-access-control'
                                description:
                                  description: A short description of the dashboard.
                                  type: string

                                  items:
                                    maxLength: 250
                                    type: string
                                  maxItems: 100
                                  type: array

                                  $ref: '#/components/schemas/Kibana_HTTP_APIs_kbn-es-query-server-timeRangeSchema'
                                title:
                                  description: The dashboard title.
                                  type: string
                              required:
                                - title

                              description: The dashboard ID.
                              type: string
                            meta:
                              $ref: '#/components/schemas/Kibana_HTTP_APIs_kbn-as-code-meta'
                          required:
                            - id
                            - data

                        type: array

                        additionalProperties: false
                        type: object

                          page:
                            default: 1
                            description: The returned page of results.

                            default: 20
                            description: The number of results returned per page.
                            maximum: 1000

                            type: number

                            description: The total number of results matching the query.
                            type: number
                        required:
                          - total

                      - data

                    type: object
                    properties:

                        items:
                          additionalProperties: false
                          type: object
                          properties:
                            data:
                              additionalProperties: false
                              type: object

                                    maxLength: 250

                              $ref: '#/components/schemas/Kibana_HTTP_APIs_kbn-as-code-meta'
                          required:
                            - id
                            - data
                            - meta
                        type: array
                      page:
                        description: The page of results returned.
                        type: number
                      total:
                        description: The total number of dashboards matching the query.
                        type: number
                    required:
                      - dashboards
                      - page
                      - total
          description: success
        '400':
          description: bad request
        '403':
          description: forbidden

          description: internal server error

          source: |

**1. What the data holds.** The "Kibana Sample Data Logs" data view uses `timestamp` as its time field. It covers:
- **Request:** `url`, `request`, `extension`, `referer`, and `response`, the HTTP status code stored as text, with `response.keyword` for exact matching.
- **Size:** `bytes`.
- **Client:** `clientip`, `agent`, `machine.os`, and `machine.ram`.
- **Location:** `geo.src`, `geo.dest`, and `geo.coordinates`.
- **Other:** `host` and `tags`, plus an `hour_of_day` field calculated from the timestamp.

**2. Dashboard "EFF-6cb646ac Web logs overview"** (id `99c4f0da-7891-4d93-9dc3-e1aad350f74d`, default time range last 7 days). It has 8 panels:
- Four headline numbers: total requests, unique visitors (distinct client IPs), average response size, and total bytes served.
- Requests over time, as stacked bars split by response code.
- A donut chart of requests by response code.
- A table of the top 10 requested URLs.
- A donut chart of requests by operating system.

**3. Rule "EFF-6cb646ac 5xx spike"** (id `5f6dcb09-52df-48b6-a2ae-7bf58764effe`). It's an Elasticsearch query rule on the web-logs data view:
- It runs every minute.
- It fires when more than 10 matching documents arrive in the last 5 minutes.
- It counts requests matching `response.keyword >= 500 and response.keyword < 600`, which picks up every 5xx code.

The rule has no actions attached, so when it fires it only records an alert in Kibana and doesn't notify anyone. If you want an email or Slack message, you'll need to add a connector to it.

The "no alerts" result on the first run only means there weren't more than 10 5xx requests in that 5-minute window. I didn't separately run the query to check that it matches 5xx documents.
